content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR IITR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR IITR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Toxicology Research (CSIR IITR), located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, for filling multiple project staff positions under various ongoing research projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in CSIR IITR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 31 vacancies available across different posts including Project Associate, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist, Junior Research Assistant, Project Assistant, and Project Technical Support.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and last dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 1 October 2026 and concludes on 7 October 2026. Candidates must submit their application forms within this window to be considered eligible for the positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates is Nil, meaning applicants do not have to pay any fee to submit their online application forms for these contractual posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to CSIR IITR posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, and women as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Zoology, Environmental Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Toxicology, Biotechnology, Microbiology, M.Tech in Life Sciences, M.V.Sc., or B.Tech in Biotechnology to apply for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 67,000 per month plus HRA depending on the specific post, educational qualifications, and relevant post-qualification experience of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based entirely on an interview process. A tentative list of eligible candidates will be published on the official website prior to the scheduled interview dates.

faq.question: Q9. When are the interviews scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: Interviews for posts like Project Associate-II, Senior Project Associate, and Project Scientist-I are scheduled for 22 October 2026, while interviews for Project Associate-I, Junior Research Assistant, and Project Assistant-I will be held on 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of the Indian Institute of Toxicology Research at https://www.iitr.res.in or by using the direct application link provided.
